nodes.label: Camera-Only Live Capture Component
nodes.rationale: Filament's stock FileUpload cannot enforce camera-only. Needs custom Livewire/Alpine component using browser native camera capture API. Client-side enforcement is soft guarantee — pair with server-side check on embedded capture metadata (timestamp/recency) as defense in depth.

nodes.label: Client Portal Removal & Emailed PDF Reports
nodes.rationale: Removal of client Filament portal in favor of emailed PDF reports is deliberate, not an oversight. Client role retained as data record but no longer panel-accessible. Re-adding client panel/login routes requires explicit approval.
nodes.norm_label: client portal removal & emailed pdf reports

nodes.label: Deficit Carry-Forward Engine
nodes.rationale: daily_target is system-computed only (baseline + carried deficit). Scheduled job must run before day's shift reports are evaluated for warnings, or daily_target used for warning check will be stale. Warning notification fires once on first breach (first_triggered_at), not on repeat evaluation.

nodes.label: Automated Delay Cascade & Mitigation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Delay-cascade date shift and sub_job_delay_events creation must happen atomically in one transaction — don't leave cascade as separate un-atomic follow-up step. A delay recorded without corresponding downstream date shift (or vice versa) leaves project timeline inconsistent with its own audit trail.

nodes.label: Overtime Calculation (hourly_rate = daily_rate / 8)
nodes.rationale: Leaning toward env-configurable STANDARD_WORKDAY_HOURS for consistency with delay-threshold pattern, rather than hardcoding 8.

nodes.label: Weight Validation (incremental model)
nodes.rationale: Incremental model chosen over strict-100-on-each-save: individual weights may be any value and need not sum to 100 on each save, but validation rejects any save that pushes the set past 100% and blocks adding a new row once siblings already total 100%. Sets build up to exactly 100% and stop there. Guided by admin bell reminder rather than hard block.

nodes.label: Worker Attendance (payroll source of truth)
nodes.rationale: worker_attendance is the payroll source of truth; daily_report_workers is not. Don't accidentally wire payroll calculations to the SE's allocation Repeater data.
